items.title: 5.13.1 Liquid crystals ki aam khusoosiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.13.1, printed page 112.

blocks.text: Liquid crystals ki aam khusoosiyat yeh hain.

items: Un ki mutawazi, ba-tarteeb tarteeb hai.
Un ke molecules lambe, chhari-numa aur khatti hain.
Woh liquids ki tarah behte hain.
Woh liquids ki tarah viscosity dikhate hain.
Woh crystals ki tarah optical khusoosiyat dikhate hain.
Woh kisi had tak sakht hain.

blocks.caption: Liquid crystals ka dono halaton se muqabla

blocks.prompt: Woh khusoosiyat batayein jin mein liquid crystals solids se milte hain, aur woh jin mein liquids se.
blocks.explanation: Solids ki tarah un ki ba-tarteeb mutawazi tarteeb, crystal jaisi optical khusoosiyat, kuch sakhti aur anisotropy hai. Liquids ki tarah woh behte hain aur viscosity dikhate hain.

items: Liquid crystals: mutawazi ba-tarteeb, chhari-numa khatti molecules; liquids ki tarah behna aur viscosity; crystals ki tarah optical khusoosiyat; kisi had tak sakht; hamesha anisotropic.
